1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 2) covers the method of measurement of concrete works in building and civil engineering works.
NOTE - The method of measurement of concrete work in piling, wells and tunnelling is covered respectively in IS 1200 (Part 23) 'Method of measurement of building and civil engineering works: Part 23 Piling (fourth revision)', IS 1200 (Part 24) 'Method of measurement of building and civil engineering works: Part 24 Well foundations (third revision)' and IS 1200 (Part 25) 'Method of measurement of building and civil engineering works: Part 25 Tunnelling (second revision)'.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
